descFull: Debloat your Mac from the terminal: disable 307 non-essential macOS launchd services (Siri, Apple Intelligence, telemetry, ads) plus Spotlight, and keep them off across reboots. Works with SIP on; turn SIP off from the menu to disable every label. One-key presets, fully reversible, zero deps. macOS 26 and 27, Apple Silicon.
